title: Core: AS2 class extends and multiple constructors
description: Test compilation of: (1) class extends with super() call, (2) class with no constructor (implicit default), (3) class constructor calling super with arguments, (4) class with both constructor and static initializer, (5) constructor chaining. Verify ActionNew (0x4a) for instantiation, ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) for constructor body, ActionCallMethod (0x52) for super(). Test that the prototype chain is correctly set up in bytecode.
